order_book: The region accounts for almost 22% of our order book and L1 pipeline.
Our order book remains strong and stands at a record level of INR40,000 crores as of date.
On the order intake front, we secured orders of over INR13,500 crores, of which 70% is from T&D.
guidance: And we expect another INR150 crores to come in hopefully within this quarter, otherwise, at least January.
We expect the debt levels to come down to almost INR6,000 crores by the end of the year.
capex: In India, strong demand drivers such as rising power consumption, accelerated renewable energy integration, grid modernization, expansion of transmission infrastructure and the evacuation requirements under the GEC Phase
On the new product front, while part of the facility has got commissioned, we expect Elastomeric cables and E-Beam to commence production in Q3.
risks: These challenges have slowed revenue accrual on certain projects during the quarter due to delayed supplies of equipment and also steel to our factory.
The performance during the quarter was impacted by a combination of external headwinds and project-specific challenges.
focus: In international, the business has strengthened its order book with multiple wins, including its re-entry into Bhutan, further diversifying its international footprint.
In line with our strategy of diversifying our product portfolio and expanding into new markets, we continue to make encouraging progress in SAE.
